question: Do supervised PopQA probes separate wrong vs correct beyond output confidence?

populations.P2_all: all graded correct+wrong rows; stratified 5-fold, group = popqa_id; base includes log_s_pop + relation one-hot
populations.P3_relation_out: all graded correct+wrong rows; leave-relation-group-out; descriptive transfer only

label: y=1 wrong, y=0 correct; abstain and ambiguous excluded; DEGENERATE counted as wrong (Addendum B)
multiplicity: Holm across C1 and C2 at alpha 0.05 on one-sided bootstrap p-values
layer_selection: inside outer-train folds, joint with C, by inner-CV AUROC
